access_rule: XCN+S from fixed terrain observer; clearance >=0.1 deg above interpolated 2 m curated horizon
backhaul_rule: Moving-Moon photon path >=100 m above sampled LDEM_64 terrain AND XCN spherical-limb clearance >=0.1 deg; CN+S station reception >=10.35 deg at arrival; any one named reference antenna
hour_rule: Every sample including both endpoints must pass; this is sampled visibility, not continuous-time certification
force_frame: MOON_PA_DE421; explicit ICRF transform, DE421 planetary translation retained
horizon_convention: samples at (index+0.5)*360/720 degrees; cyclic linear interpolation

metadata.label_limitations: 45-degree band edge artifacts; interpolated incomplete coverage; no per-pixel error bound

source.extrema_note: Observed raster extrema differ from, but lie within, the label extrema; source discrepancy retained, not fitted away

limb_terrain.method: Finite straight inertial photon segment; Moon translation and ME421 rotation linearized at closest photon approach; exact SPICE shell-end/minimum checks <=1 m
limb_terrain.bounds: Actual DEM minimum/maximum spheres only accelerate definite interior/exterior rays; sampled radial clearance near limb

orbit_interpolation_check.method: cubic Hermite from positions/velocities; comparison with fine dense integration at all withheld bin midpoints

pre_epoch_light_time_halo.method: backward DOP853, same forces; forward RK45 round trip

relay_sources.purpose: Research reference orbits, not operational provider ephemerides

limitations: Reference design, rounded states and unresolved element-table residuals; not operational trajectories
Sampled horizon/occultation with explicit sensitivity margins, not uncertainty bounds
Backhaul terrain uses 474 m LDEM_64 grid with sampled rays and 100 m engineering guard; sub-grid peaks, DEM errors, diffraction/Fresnel zones are not resolved
Existing 0.1-degree spherical-limb guard is retained, so topographic valleys never add contacts
Generic 10-degree receiver mask plus 0.35-degree Earth-orientation stress; no local station masks
Rates, RF closure, pointing, relay power, allocation, antenna switching and service availability remain assumptions
Single spacecraft only; no data teleportation or pooled buffer across satellites
No extrapolation outside the generated plan
